name: marlowe-vscode
description: Connects Marlowe to this editor: the selection and open files, diagnostics, diffs and a notebook kernel, over a loopback MCP server.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace Marlowe can read the selection, open files and diagnostics, but cannot open diffs against files or run code in a kernel.

marlowe.home.markdownDescription: Marlowe's profile folder. Empty means `$MARLOWE_HOME`, else `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MarloweCowork`. The connection file goes in its `ide` folder.

marlowe.enabled.description: Offer this editor to Marlowe. Turning it off removes the connection file.

scripts.package: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --allow-missing-repository -o dist/marlowe-vscode.vsix
